tags.name: Kanban
tags.description: Kanban boards: members and roles, columns with WIP limits, cards with labels, assignees, priorities, dates, subtasks, comments and attachments, and an activity log. Boards are visible only to their members; poll a board cheaply with `If-None-Match`.

get.description:
Boards the caller is a member of, by name, with their members and counters. Without `archived` (or with `archived=false`) active boards are listed, with `archived=true` the archived ones.

**Scope:** `kanban:read`

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: List archived boards instead of active ones.

post.description:
Creates a board owned by the caller (at most 500 per user). `template` `basic` (the default) adds the columns "To do", "In progress" and "Done".

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

get.description:
The board with members, labels, columns and cards (archived cards only with `include_archived`). The response carries `ETag: "<version>"`; poll with `If-None-Match` while the board is open — an unchanged board answers 304 without a body. Boards are visible only to their members (server admins included); others are 404.

**Scope:** `kanban:read`

patch.description:
Renames, describes, recolors, archives or restores the board (board admins).

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

delete.description:
Deletes the board with its columns, cards, comments and attachments (the owner only).

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

put.description:
Full replacement of the member list besides the owner (board admins); at most 100 members including the owner. Removed members are unassigned from the board's cards and subtasks.

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

422.description: Unknown user, invalid role, a user listed twice, too many members, or the caller removing themselves.

post.description:
Removes the caller from the board (any member but the owner) and from its cards' and subtasks' assignees.

**Scope:** `kanban:read`

409.description: The owner cannot leave; transfer the board first.

post.description:
Makes another member the owner (the owner only); the previous owner becomes an admin.

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

200.description: The board as the previous owner now sees it.

409.description: The new owner already owns 500 boards.

422.description: `user_id` is not a member (or is the caller).

get.description:
The board's activity log, newest first (the newest 10 000 entries are kept); `card_id` narrows it to one card (also a deleted one).

**Scope:** `kanban:read`

post.description:
Adds a label to the board (editors; at most 200 per board, names unique case-insensitively).

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

409.description: The name is taken or the board has 200 labels.

post.description:
Adds a column (editors; at most 100 per board) at `position` (clamped; default: last), shifting the columns after it.

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

get.description:
Up to 20 enabled accounts whose username or display name starts with `q` (case-insensitive for ASCII), for adding members. Queries shorter than 2 characters answer `[]`. Email addresses are never returned.

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

409.description: Another label of the board has that name.

delete.description:
Deletes a label and removes it from every card (editors; the cards' versions move on).

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

patch.description:
Renames, recolors, sets the advisory WIP limit or collapses a column (editors).

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

delete.description:
Deletes a column (editors). While it holds cards (archived ones too) the request is 409 with `details.card_count`, unless `move_cards_to` names another column of the board: the cards are then appended there in their order.

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

parameters.name: move_cards_to
parameters.description: Another column of the same board that receives the cards.

409.description: The column holds cards and `move_cards_to` is missing.

422.description: `move_cards_to` is not another column of this board.

post.description:
Moves a column to `position` (clamped), shifting the columns in between (editors).

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

200.description: The board's columns in their new order.

post.description:
Adds a card to the column (editors; at most 10 000 cards per board, archived included) at `position` (clamped; default: end). Labels must be of the board and assignees members. For all-day dates send the start of the local day as `start_at` and its end as `due_at`.

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

422.description: Invalid field, or a label/assignee that is not of this board.

get.description:
Cards across the caller's boards (cards of archived boards only with `board_id`), or one board, by due date (cards without one last), then board, column and position. `due=overdue` is `due_at` in the past and not completed; `today` and `week` are the next 24 hours / 7 days by the server's clock; `none` / `any`: without / with a due date. `q` matches title and description (and `#12` the card number). Archived cards only with `archived=true`. Descriptions are cut to 200 characters.

**Scope:** `kanban:read`

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text in title or description, or `#<number>`.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Archived cards instead of the others.

get.description:
The card with all its subtasks and attachments, the newest 100 comments and the newest 50 activity entries.

**Scope:** `kanban:read`

patch.description:
Changes card fields (editors). With `base_version` a stale edit is 409 with `details.current`; a request that changes nothing keeps the version. Use the move endpoint to change column or position.

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

422.description: Invalid field, a label/assignee not of this board, or a cover that is not an image attachment of this card.

delete.description:
Deletes the card permanently with its subtasks, comments and attachments (editors). Archive it instead to keep it.

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

post.description:
Moves the card within its column or to another column of the board (editors), shifting the siblings; `position` is clamped and defaults to the end of the column.

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

422.description: `column_id` is not a column of the card's board.

post.description:
Adds a checklist item (editors; at most 200 per card).

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

Adds a Markdown comment (any member, viewers included; at most 5000 per card).

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

Attaches the raw request body (at most 50 MiB) to the card (editors; at most 100 attachments per card and 2 GiB of attachments per board). Writes keep 1 GiB of free space on the data volume, like file uploads.

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

507.description: `quota_exceeded`: the board's 2 GiB of attachments are used up; `insufficient_storage`: the server is low on disk space.

post.description:
Copies a Files entry the caller can read into an attachment (editors; tokens also need `files:read`; at most 50 MiB).

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

403.description: Not an editor of the board, or the token lacks `files:read`.

404.description: The card, or a file the caller can read, does not exist.

413.description: The file is larger than 50 MiB.

patch.description:
Renames, checks, schedules or assigns a subtask (editors).

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

post.description:
Moves a subtask to `position` (clamped) within its card (editors).

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

200.description: The card's subtasks in their new order.

post.summary: Turn a subtask into a card
post.description:
Creates a card right below the subtask's card (same column, title, due date, assignee; completed when the subtask was done) and deletes the subtask (editors).

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

patch.description:
Changes a comment's body (its author only); it is then marked `edited`.

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

delete.description:
Deletes a comment (its author or a board admin).

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

get.description:
The attachment bytes with the Files content headers: browser-displayable images (not SVG) are inline with their type unless `download=1`; everything else is an `application/octet-stream` attachment. Responses carry `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, a sandboxing CSP and an ETag, and support Range requests.

**Scope:** `kanban:read` · also accepts `?access_token=`

patch.description:
Changes the attachment's file name (editors); the content and its type stay.

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

delete.description:
Deletes an attachment (editors, or its uploader while still a member); a card cover using it is cleared.

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

get.description:
A JPEG thumbnail (longest edge 160 px for `sm`, 320 px for `md`, the default) of a JPEG, PNG or GIF attachment, decoded under the server's shared image decode budget; 404 for other files and images that cannot be decoded.

**Scope:** `kanban:read` · also accepts `?access_token=`

post.description:
Copies the attachment into Files (any member; tokens also need `files:write`): by default into the root of the caller's home space under the attachment's name. Quota, free-space and naming rules of Files apply.

**Scope:** `kanban:write`

403.description: The token lacks `files:write`, or the target space is read-only.

404.description: The attachment, or a writable target space, does not exist.

409.description: A file of that name exists (use `overwrite`).

KanbanColor.description: Label, board and column color names (clients map them to their palette, light and dark).

KanbanRole.description: `viewer` reads and comments; `editor` also changes columns, cards, labels, subtasks and attachments; `admin` also edits the board and its members; `owner` (exactly one) also deletes or transfers the board.

display_name.description: May be empty; clients fall back to the username.

KanbanLabel.description: A board label (unique name per board, case-insensitive).

wip_limit.description: Advisory work-in-progress limit: clients warn when `card_count` exceeds it; the server accepts more.

card_count.description: Cards in the column that are not archived.

description.description: Markdown (rendered by clients with the safe renderer). In lists (`Board.cards`, `GET /kanban/cards`) cut to its first 200 characters; `GET /kanban/cards/{id}` and card writes return it in full.

position.description: 0-based, dense per column; archived cards keep their place (clients skip them).

labels.description: Label ids of the board, by label name.

assignees.description: User ids of board members, in assignment order.

all_day.description: Dates are whole days: `start_at` is the start and `due_at` the end of the local day.

cover_attachment_id.description: An image attachment of the card shown as its cover.

created_by.description: User id of the creator (the account may no longer exist).

version.description: Incremented whenever a field `PATCH /kanban/cards/{id}` can change does (by anyone, also when a label is deleted or an assignee leaves); moves, subtasks, comments and attachments do not change it. Send it back as `base_version`.

KanbanSubtask.description: A checklist item of a card.

author_name.description: Display name (or username) of the author; `Deleted user` once the account is gone.

edited.description: The author changed the body after posting.

KanbanAttachment.description: A file attached to a card.

is_image.description: A raster image browsers display (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, AVIF, ICO; never SVG): served inline and usable as a card cover.

thumbnail_url.description: JPEG thumbnail URL for JPEG, PNG and GIF images (append `?size=sm|md`); `null` when there is none.

KanbanActivity.description: An entry of a board's activity log.

actor_name.description: `Deleted user` once the account is gone.

meta.description: Action details: names and titles at the time of the change, ids, `fields` for updates.

KanbanActivityPage.description: A page of activity, newest first.

KanbanCommentPage.description: A page of comments, oldest first.

comments.description: The newest 100 comments in chronological order (page older ones with `GET /kanban/cards/{id}/comments`).

activity.description: The newest 50 activity entries of the card.

KanbanCardDetail.description: A card with its subtasks, attachments, comments and activity.

KanbanBoard.description: A board with everything clients need to show it.

members.description: Owner first, then admins, editors and viewers, by name.

cards.description: By column and position; without archived cards unless `include_archived` (descriptions cut to 200 characters).

updated_at.description: Last change to the board or anything on it.

version.description: Incremented by every change to the board or anything on it; also the `ETag`.

KanbanBoardSummary.description: A board in the board list.

KanbanUser.description: An account that can be added as a member (never with its email address).

members.description: Every member besides the owner (an entry for the owner is ignored); members missing from the list are removed and unassigned from cards and subtasks. You cannot remove yourself (leave instead).

position.description: Clamped to the valid range; default: last.
0-based target position, clamped to the valid range.
Clamped to the valid range; default: end of the column.

labels.description: Replaces the labels (`null` or `[]` clears them).

assignees.description: Replaces the assignees, in order (`null` or `[]` clears them).

cover_attachment_id.description: An image attachment of this card; `null` clears the cover.

base_version.description: The card `version` the edit is based on; a stale one is 409 with `details.current`.

column_id.description: A column of the card's board.

position.description: Target position in the column (clamped); default: end of the column. Positions count archived cards.

file_id.description: A Files entry the caller can read (at most 50 MiB).

space_id.description: Target space; default: the caller's home.

path.description: Target folder (created when missing); default: the space root.

name.description: File name; default: the attachment's name.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file of that name (its old content goes to the trash).

KanbanConflictError.description: 409 body for a stale `base_version`: `details.current` is the card as it is now.
